title: ALU
body:
Arithmetic Logic Unit

The [[Combinational Logic|combinational]] block that does the actual computing: two operand
inputs, a function-select input, one result output, plus the condition flags. Arithmetic
comes from an [[adder-subtractor]]; the logical operations are gates in parallel; a
[[Multiplexer]] on the outputs picks which result the function-select asked for.

No memory, no clock. The registers around it hold the state; the ALU is a pure function of
its inputs. The flags it produces (zero, negative, carry, overflow) are the
[[Status Bits]] that conditional branches test.
